caution_findings.evidence_context: The selected paper discusses sublancin as an antimicrobial peptide and cites prior antibacterial work, but this article reports immunomodulatory, Caco-2 transport, cytotoxicity-threshold, biodistribution, and hemogram outcomes rather than MIC/MBC assays.
Figures 1, 3, 4, and Figure S1 are available as images/captions without source data tables; exact bar heights were not asserted.
